title: Hide admin-only Platform Plugin tool bindings from tenant catalog discovery

phases.objective: Make tenant Platform Plugin catalog discovery reflect tenant-visible tool surfaces instead of exposing Admin or platform-only binding metadata that the execution resolver would later reject.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user listing available Platform Plugins
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The tenant catalog contains tenant-visible tool bindings only, while the Admin catalog retains its existing internal bindings and no secret values are exposed.
steps: Resolve the tenant catalog through the canonical User-JWT tenant route and mark the catalog projection with principalClass=tenant.
Load the existing Platform Plugin definition and binding rows without mutating registry state.
Apply the same admin-only tool-surface classification already enforced by tenant execution: tool_surface containing admin or exposure_scope admin, platform_admin, or platform is not tenant-visible.
Build tenant plugin manifests and tool-binding totals from the filtered projection while leaving the default Admin catalog projection unchanged.
Verify the returned catalog remains secret-free and does not expose the hidden binding keys through tool_bindings.
assertions: The tenant route explicitly requests principalClass=tenant and cannot silently fall back to the Admin projection.
A tenant-visible device tool remains discoverable.
An admin tool surface is absent from tenant tool_bindings.
A platform_admin exposure is absent from tenant tool_bindings even when its tool_surface name itself is not admin-prefixed.
Tenant tool-binding totals count only tenant-visible bindings.
The default/Admin catalog retains the same admin and platform tool bindings for operational callers.
The change does not alter action-binding semantics, execute a provider operation, apply a migration, mutate Production, or expose credentials or secrets.
